description: The playroom around the dollhouse: a soft pastel lilac or pink wall with faint stars or polka dots, a blurred toy shelf or window light at the far left and right edges, and a light wooden table top from y≈930 to the bottom. Keep x 250–1670 and y 20–950 plain and soft, because the dollhouse, roof and title are drawn on top. The top-left (x 0–260, y 0–350) and top-right (x 1660–1920, y 0–200) corners hold UI panels, and the characters stand in the bottom corners.

Menu card: a cozy pink-striped bedroom seen from the front: a window with pink curtains, a white bed with a pink polka-dot blanket and a heart headboard, a unicorn plushie on the pillow, a nightstand with a glowing yellow lamp, a round purple rug, a teddy bear, a potted plant, fairy lights and a framed picture. Warm and sparkly. No text. The code's drawIcon shows this layout today.

360×212 | blanket pink #ff8fc2 | Side view, headboard on the left (the code flips it). Cream wooden frame, a tall rounded headboard with a heart cut-out, a lower rounded footboard, a white mattress and pillow, and a pink polka-dot blanket over the right two-thirds with a folded top edge. The mattress top must sit about 54% of the height up from the bottom, because characters bounce on it and plushies sit there.
116×126 | paint cream #fff1e2 | Small two-drawer bedside table with gold round knobs and short legs. Flat top at the very top of the canvas, since small items sit on it.
190×166 | fabric pink #ff8fc2 | Front view: a puffy rounded armchair with tufted back buttons, a plump seat cushion, round arms and little wooden legs. Seat cushion top at about 50% of the height.
160×112 | fabric pink #ff8fc2 | Squishy teardrop beanbag with a dent where you sit and a shiny highlight.

236×148 | paint cream #fff1e2 | Simple writing desk with two legs on the left, a two-drawer unit on the right and a flat top.

220×170 | mane and saddle pink #ff8fc2 | Side view, head on the right: a cream wooden rocking horse on curved wooden rockers, with a pink curly mane, tail and saddle and a happy face. The bottom of the rockers sits on the canvas bottom, because the code rocks it around that point.
150×160 | roof pink #ff8fc2 | A tiny toy dollhouse: cream walls, a pink roof with a white heart, blue windows and a little door.

160×70 | cushion pink #ff8fc2 | The front half of the rim only, aligned pixel for pixel with room-petbed, with a small paw print. It is drawn over the sleeping kitty.
72×106 | shade pink #ff8fc2 | Table lamp with a round cream base, a gold stem and a flared pleated shade. Bottom-centre anchored (it stands on tables and on the floor).

256×232 | curtains pink #ff8fc2 | White window frame with a cross bar, a sill, a gold curtain rod and two pink curtains tied back with gold bands. The glass must be transparent: the code draws the day or night sky behind it in the rectangle x 84–428, y 64–384 of the 512×464 canvas (window centre at 256, 232).
